falsifier: fewer claims than the corpus band (about 3.4 must-finds) rest on such a fact, or every such fact reduces to one predicate
hypothesis: after registry version 8, a material share of the corpus's reference claims rest on a fact the sources state and no predicate or graph field can hold
intervention: read all 331 reference claims of the 13 tuned cases (242 STRIDE, 89 ASVS) against each case's source, stated model attributes and signed facts, and classed the fact each claim rests on: structure 17, field 39, predicate 52, silent 222, none 1. Must-finds: silent 88, predicate 36, field 23, structure 6, none 0. The one fact no predicate holds: case 08's group membership and leavers reach the directory only through a nightly pull (08 stride 16 rests on it; 08 stride 19 and 08 asvs 2 rest on it in part). Three signed rows may understate their source: 04 'we have never expired one' (credential-expiry and credential-rotation read unknown), 04 'Redis has no password on it' (authentication-mechanism reads unknown), and 10 the admin reaching the database from anywhere with no jump host (no internet-exposure row)
reconsider_when: a new case enters the corpus, the registry versions, or a sitting re-reads a case
scope: tuned cases only, holdouts excluded; one agent's reading, not signed; it reads only facts some reference claim rests on, so a stated fact no claim uses is not counted; it says a predicate exists, not that the assert node writes it
signature: a reference claim rests on a stated fact no assertion predicate can hold
